title: Reliable F0 estimation with multi-candidate CMND and Viterbi continuity
hypothesis: Multi-candidate CMND with harmonic-support scoring and Viterbi continuity reads 110-350 Hz sustained vowels and the 110->220 Hz, 300->130 Hz and 200+-12 Hz@5 Hz contours within 50 cents at the default 65-900 Hz range (no fmax narrowing), and on 12 real AISHELL-3 utterances it removes most of the octave jumps of the single-dip estimator while explicitly rejecting frames it cannot resolve instead of interpolating.

git.status: dirty: uncommitted pitch tracker (src/vhe/data/pitch.py, f0.cmnd_curve, data exports, tests/test_data_pitch.py)

notes: Synthetic 8/8 contours hit50=1.00, octave errors 0.00 at default fmax 900 (legacy default 0.02 at 210/300 Hz). v1 with frame_ms=40 failed the 300->130 glide (0.84/0.16) and is kept as the window-length ablation. Real 12 utterances: mean rejection 0.4835 (27% of non-silent frames), octave jump rate 0.0027 vs legacy 0.0248. No listening test. Directory was recreated with tools/new_experiment.py after an initial hand-made creation; artifacts restored and md5-checked.
